req.title: Status code sentence body
req.statement: The system shall include the standard reason phrase in the body when responding to /status/<code> with a code between 400 and 599.

doc.reasoning: R-HTTPBIN-045 requires that GET /status/<code> for codes 400-599 returns a response whose body contains the standard HTTP reason phrase. The status_code() helper in helpers.py builds the response via make_response() and sets r.status_code; Flask/Werkzeug automatically populates the status line with the reason phrase, and httpbin echoes it in the body for this range. Tests must: (1) confirm a representative 4xx code returns the phrase in the body (EP positive), (2) confirm a representative 5xx code returns the phrase (EP positive), (3) confirm the exact boundary codes 400 and 599 behave correctly (BVA), (4) confirm code 399 (just below the range) does NOT include a 4xx reason phrase in the body (BVA negative), (5) confirm code 600 (just above the range) does NOT include a 5xx reason phrase (BVA negative), and (6) confirm an invalid non-numeric code returns 400 with an error body (NEG). Assertions use exact string membership and exact status codes to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_status_400_body_contains_reason_phrase
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
expected: HTTP response status code is exactly 400
Response body contains 'BAD REQUEST' (case-insensitive) — the standard reason phrase for 400
trace: R-HTTPBIN-045: body must include standard reason phrase for 400-599
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_400_body_contains_reason_phrase():
    r = client.get('/status/400')
    assert r.status_code == 400
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').upper()
    assert 'BAD REQUEST' in body

test_status_400_body_contains_reason_phrase()

tests.name: test_status_401_body_contains_unauthorized
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
401 has a special entry in code_map (adds WWW-Authenticate header)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-045: 401 is in code_map with custom headers; body must still contain reason phrase
DT: code_map special-case branch for 401 must not suppress reason phrase
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_status_401_body_contains_unauthorized():
    r = client.get('/status/401')
    assert r.status_code == 401, f'Expected 401, got {r.status_code}'
    body = r.data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').upper()
    assert 'UNAUTHORIZED' in body, f'Reason phrase UNAUTHORIZED missing: {body!r}'
    assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in r.headers or 'www-authenticate' in r.headers

test_status_401_body_contains_unauthorized()
